name: Amazing Grace
plainLyrics:
Amazing grace
How sweet the sound
That would save
A wretch like me
I once was lost
But now I've been found
I was blind but now I see
Amazing grace
How sweet the sound
That would save
A wretch like me
I once was lost
But now I've been found
I was blind but now I see
It was grace that taught me
Not to fear
And so grace my fears relieved
How precious did that
Grace should appear
The hour I first belleved
Through all the dangers
Toils and snares
I have already come
It was grace that brought me
Safe this far
And so grace will carry me home
We've been here for
10 thousand years
Bright shining like the sun
May we know more days
To sing loves praise
Than when we first begun
Amazing grace
How sweet the sound
That would save
A wretch like me
I once was lost
But now I've been found
I was blind but now I see
